levels.surface: عبد الرحمن بن أبي عبد الله

notes: «وَ رَوَى اَلْفَضْلُ وَ عَبْدُ اَلرَّحْمَنِ» : two co-transmitters of one level, both reporting from the Imam.
The Imam after «عن» is a narrator (owner ruling 2); the saying is his, and the Prophet is only named inside it.
The route «given elsewhere» flag is not written: the text gives no further chain.
